# LivePhoto

> Free, 100% on-device online tool to convert videos (MP4, MOV, WebM) and animated GIFs into authentic Apple Live Photos (.zip asset pairs) for iPhone dynamic lockscreen wallpapers and Photos library.

LivePhoto (https://livephoto.skillary.ai/) enables creators and iPhone users to turn any motion clip into genuine Apple-compatible Live Photo assets. Processing runs entirely in the user's browser using HTML5 Canvas, client-side video decoding, and WebAssembly, ensuring absolute privacy with zero server uploads.

## Core Capabilities
- Video to Live Photo: Convert MP4, MOV, and WebM videos into paired JPG + MOV files compatible with iOS lockscreens.
- GIF to Live Photo: Transform animated GIFs into Apple Live Photos with customizable static cover frame selection.
- TikTok & Social Media to Live Wallpaper: Convert vertical 9:16 clips from TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts into full-screen iPhone dynamic wallpapers.
- Live Photo to GIF / MP4: Extract animated GIFs or high-definition video tracks from existing Live Photo bundles.
- 3D Touch & Haptic Press Simulation: Interactive iPhone lockscreen simulator providing real-time pressure preview of motion wallpapers.
- 100% On-Device & Private: Zero files sent to the cloud; synthesis occurs completely inside local browser memory.

## Technical Specifications
- Still Image Component: Standard JPEG image with Apple MakerNote Key 17 containing the exact com.apple.quicktime.content.identifier UUID string.
- Motion Video Component: QuickTime MOV container with matching mdta:com.apple.quicktime.content.identifier metadata and com.apple.quicktime.still-image-time set to the chosen cover frame.
- Pairing Mechanism: When both files share an identical UUID and are imported via the iOS Files app (Share -> "Save to Photos"), iOS Photos framework automatically links them into a single native Live Photo.
- Supported Duration: 1.5 seconds (standard), 2.5 seconds (recommended for lockscreens), or 3.0 seconds (maximum).
- Supported Aspect Ratios: 9:16 vertical iPhone wallpaper format or original source aspect ratio.

## Step-by-Step User Instructions
1. Navigate to https://livephoto.skillary.ai/ or a dedicated tool endpoint.
2. Drop or upload an MP4, MOV, or GIF file (up to 200MB).
3. Select the desired Live Photo duration and drag the scrubber slider to select the still cover frame.
4. Click "Download Live Photo Pair (.ZIP)".
5. On your iPhone:
   - Open the downloaded .zip file in the Files (文件) app and tap to extract it.
   - Tap "Select" in the top right corner, then select both the .JPG and .MOV files.
   - Tap the Share (分享) icon in the bottom left, then choose "Save to Photos" (存储到“照片”).
   - Open the Photos (照片) app; the item will display the native "LIVE" badge.
   - Go to Settings -> Wallpaper -> Add New Wallpaper -> Live Photo to set it as a dynamic wallpaper.
